subject: Oceanography
title: The Northwest Passage
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Northwest Passage.

hook.text: For 400 years, explorers died trying to find a sea route through Arctic Canada—ice always stopped them.

buildup.text: The Northwest Passage connects the Atlantic and Pacific across the Canadian Arctic Archipelago.

discovery.text: Roald Amundsen completed the first transit in 1906—a three-year voyage through ice-choked channels.

twist.text: In 2007, the passage opened completely ice-free for the first time in recorded history.

climax.text: Shipping companies now eye the route—it's 7,000 km shorter than the Panama Canal for some voyages.

punchline.text: The route explorers died for is now opening—because the ice is dying.

quiz.question: Who first completed the Northwest Passage?
